scripts.typecheck: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro sync && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.json
scripts.wrangler:dry-run: bash -euo pipefail -c 'repo_root=$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)"); scratch="$repo_root/../recording/bitty-website"; mkdir -p "$scratch/wrangler-dry-run"; log="$scratch/wrangler-dry-run.log"; timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=5s --preserve-status 15s env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir "$scratch/wrangler-dry-run" 2>&1 | tee "$log"; grep -Fq -- "--dry-run: exiting now." "$log"; grep -Fq -- "No bindings found." "$log"'
scripts.check: bun run sync:manual && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run validate:dist && bun run audit:a11y && bun run wrangler:dry-run
